title: Code for: Task-specific performance of locally fine-tuned large language models for tabular clinical prediction: a controlled comparison with machine-learning models
description: Minimal code package for three tabular clinical prediction tasks (warfarin discharge dose regression; one-year major adverse cardiac events after myocardial infarction; five-year mortality after allogeneic hematopoietic cell transplantation): key-value serialization and instruction templates (including the field-name variants), Unsloth/LoRA fine-tuning and inference of four 4-bit open-weight LLMs (Qwen2.5-3B/7B/14B-Instruct, Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct) with the hyperparameter configuration, original-setting ML baselines (XGBoost, LightGBM, AdaBoost and the other original-study models; fixed seed, validation-based selection), the evaluation code (discrimination, calibration, recalibration, paired bootstrap, decision curves, operating thresholds), and data-free drawing code for forest plots, decision curves, reliability diagrams and confusion matrices. Example input files contain entirely synthetic patients. No patient-level data, predictions, adapters or model weights are included.
